definition: share of EA reviewers whose playtime_forever equals playtime_at_review exactly - they never played again after reviewing
why_it_is_here: the churn signal itself. 22% of all rows corpus-wide. averaging this into a mean persistence destroys it, so it gets its own column

definition: median of (playtime_forever - playtime_at_review) over EA reviewers, hours
why_it_is_here: the novel retention proxy. median not mean - the distribution is violently right skewed and 22% of it sits at exactly zero

definition: 75th percentile of post-review persistence over EA reviewers, hours
why_it_is_here: keeps signal when the median is pinned at zero by the churn mass

definition: median playtime_forever at the moment of reviewing, in hours
why_it_is_here: controls for prior investment - persistence means something different for a 2 hour player than a 200 hour one

definition: days between first and last EA review
why_it_is_here: how long the game spent in early access - a confounder for every volume measure

definition: EA rows actually collected for this game
why_it_is_here: the sample size behind every aggregate here. NOT a volume measure - it is capped per window, so for popular games it is a collection budget

definition: n_ea_reviews_collected divided by ea_duration_days
why_it_is_here: activity rate. a lower bound where the cap binds, which is why collection_completeness travels with it

definition: share of EA reviews with voted_up = true
why_it_is_here: THE baseline competitor - the one number a studio already has for free. the model has to beat this or it has not earned its complexity

definition: ea_positive_share in the second half of EA minus the first half
why_it_is_here: direction of travel. a game souring during EA is the pattern the score exists to catch early

definition: median num_games_owned of EA reviewers
why_it_is_here: controls for reviewer type - a 900 game library is a different reviewer

definition: median num_reviews written by EA reviewers
why_it_is_here: the same control from the other direction

definition: share of EA reviews edited after posting
why_it_is_here: edited reviews carry a recomputed EA flag - this quantifies that exposure and explains the flag/timestamp disagreement

definition: mean Detoxify toxicity over sampled EA reviews
why_it_is_here: the level of hostility during early access

definition: share of sampled EA reviews scoring toxicity > 0.5
why_it_is_here: a small permanently hostile core matters more than the average, and the mean hides it

definition: mean VADER compound over sampled EA reviews
why_it_is_here: tone independent of hostility - a review can be sad without being toxic

definition: share of sampled EA reviews where Steam redacted profanity
why_it_is_here: a profanity measure that survives Steam censoring the text

definition: sampled EA reviews carrying toxicity scores
why_it_is_here: the sample size behind every tone feature above

definition: mean toxicity in the second half of EA minus the first half
why_it_is_here: a community souring during EA is the early warning the score is for

definition: reviews collected in the 180 days after the bisected launch date
why_it_is_here: the denominator behind every outcome below

definition: share of post-launch reviews with voted_up = true
why_it_is_here: RQ1 outcome - did the game land well with players after full release

definition: median post-review persistence of post-launch reviewers, in hours
why_it_is_here: RQ1 retention outcome, measured the same way as the EA predictor

definition: mean toxicity over all sampled post-launch reviews
why_it_is_here: RQ2 outcome without the cohort control - reported for comparison only

definition: mean toxicity over sampled post-launch reviews, EXCLUDING anyone who also reviewed during EA
why_it_is_here: RQ2 headline outcome - the circularity-controlled version

definition: sampled post-launch reviews removed by the EA-reviewer exclusion
why_it_is_here: the control removes almost nobody - reporting the number is the honest version of applying it

definition: total review count Steam reports for the game via query_summary
why_it_is_here: the only trustworthy volume measure. row counts are a collection budget, not a property of the game

definition: rows collected divided by total_reviews_reported
why_it_is_here: how much of the game I hold. the cap binds non-randomly on popular titles, so this has to be visible to the model rather than hidden

definition: share of rows where the Steam EA flag disagrees with the timestamp split
why_it_is_here: quantifies the edited-review effect per game - the reason cohort membership is timestamp-based and only the text description is flag-based
